page_title: STR 3-1 ETI | Strasbourg v St Etienne 26/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' St Etienne failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Dilane Bakwa is replaced by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
86' St Etienne have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St Etienne.
84' Substitution. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) on for Felix Lemarechal.
83' 3 - 1 Goal! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes a short pass from Felix Lemarechal in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
82' The corner is swung in but St Etienne can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

81' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne have been awarded a corner kick.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) will replace Lucas Stassin.
80' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

77' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. St Etienne are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
73' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
70' Today's match ends for Irvin Cardona who will be replaced by Benjamin Old (St Etienne).
70' Substitution. Aimen Moueffek did his best and is replaced by Louis Mouton (St Etienne).
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sebastian Nanasi will be replaced by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg).
64' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Ismael Doukoure will be replaced by Guela Doue (Strasbourg).
63' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Diego Moreira laid the ball off to Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
59' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
59' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

58' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
57' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) is able to continue to play.
55' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
54' The foul by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) was seen by Benoit Bastien who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
53' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
52' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Strasbourg earn a corner.
51' A cross from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
50' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Gautier Larsonneur is alert and denies him.
49' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
47' The ball goes behind for a corner. St Etienne will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

47' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Now St Etienne have a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45+3' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. St Etienne have a corner.
45+2' A fine pass finds Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Gautier Larsonneur reacts superbly to deny him.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The resulting set piece from St Etienne is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' Goal disallowed! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) scores but Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

39' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
37' Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
37' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
36' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
35' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
33' What a big chance! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
31' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
30' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
29' Wonderful pass from Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) for Emanuel Emegha, but they can't profit from it as Gautier Larsonneur comes off his line to collect.
27' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) makes a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Wonderful pass from Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) for Sebastian Nanasi, but they can't profit from it as Gautier Larsonneur comes off his line to collect.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diego Moreira (Strasbourg).

19' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Leo Petrot, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne), who beats Djordje Petrovic with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 1:1.

12' Strasbourg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Emanuel Emegha plays a pass to the feet of Diego Moreira (Strasbourg), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 1:0.
7' A cross into the box from Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) is cleared.

3' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Djordje Petrovic guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
1' The match has just started.
Strasbourg will kick the game off.
Benoit Bastien is the one to supervise the game today.
